---
title: "Get Started"
subtitle: "What do you need to know to start using animovement? Learn what you need in 5 articles."
toc: false
---

*animovement* is a family of R packages for movement data analysis. Each
package owns one stage of the analysis, and they all share one data structure,
the **aniframe**, so the output of one stage is the input to the next with
nothing to convert in between.

These five guides take you through those stages with one recording, from
installing the packages to speed, direction and distance travelled. Work
through them in order, since each builds on the last. Once you have the basics,
[Learn](../learn/index.qmd) is where to go further.

::: {.callout-note}
## New to R or the tidyverse?
To get the most out of *animovement*, we recommend learning the basics of R and
the [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org) first. The
[Posit primers](https://posit.cloud/learn/primers),
[R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz) and
[ModernDive](https://moderndive.com) are all good places to begin.
*animovement* is tidyverse-friendly: aniframes are tibbles, so `dplyr`,
`tidyr` and `ggplot2` work on them as they do on any other data.
:::
